name: Hamahama Brewery
about: Hamahama Brewery is the English form of 하마하마, an agricultural company at Gwakji 1-gil in Aewol-eup, on Jeju Island. The label of its Memilbogam names it as the maker.

Memilbogam is a makgeolli, filed as takju, bottled at 8 percent in 600 millilitres. It is made with domestic glutinous rice, non-glutinous rice and buckwheat, with nuruk and yeast, contains wheat, and carries a 90 day shelf life if kept refrigerated below 10 degrees.
